SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency
							WHERE ((erc.vendor = 'wm' AND erc.currency != 'CLF')
							        OR (erc.vendor = 'tokyo' AND erc.currency = 'CLF'))
								AND erc.currency IN ('USD','EUR','JPY','CHF','AUD','CNY','HKD','NZD','SEK','KRW','SGD','NOK','MXN','INR','DKK','CLF','IDR','CLP','BRL','CAD','MYR','COP','GBP','ARS','RON','RUB','PHP','ILS','PLN','PEN','LTL','LVL','SIT','SAR','ZAR','QAR','CZK','TWD','THB','PKR','TRY','ISK','KWD','AED','JOD','NGN','EGP','HUF','MAD','PGK','MOP','VES','VEF','LKR','BGN','VND','BMD','XOF','BDT','ZMW','KES','HRK','MWK','GHS','MUR','JMD','RSD','TND','KZT','UAH','TTD','OMR','TZS','BWP','UGX','BHD','ZWL','IRR','VEB','ZWG')

/* QuickSight 6ae71c0d-b5c8-4b00-9205-d8c43987210f */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

--    business_date_securities_table   : business date filter for securities
--    run_id                           : unique ETL run identifier
--    extract_timestamp_iso_8601       : extract timestamp in ISO 8601 format
--    extract_timestamp_time_zone      : time zone of the extract timestamp
--    extract_timestamp                : raw extract timestamp

    SELECT code

        ('CFCR'), ('COMRC'), ('DIVPIK'), ('DLYCMPP'), ('DLYCMPS'),

        ('MFOC'), ('MONINC'), ('OTHINC'), ('PERF'), ('PEXPIC'),
        ('PEXPOC'), ('PSUITC'), ('RINC'), ('SCOC'), ('WHT'),
        ('WHTI'), ('ACRINT+'), ('ACRINT-'), ('IPK+')
    ) AS excluded_codes(code)
)

    --------------------------------------

    --------------------------------------

    -- created by and updated by fields

    NULL                                                     AS last_updated_by,
    NULL                                                     AS last_updated_date,
    NULL                                                     AS created_by_user_group,
    NULL                                                     AS created_by,
    NULL                                                     AS date_updated,
    --------------------------------------
    -- source business dates

    --------------------------------------
    -- comment and error
    --------------------------------------

    -- investigate these
    --------------------------------------
    NULL                                                     AS investment_program,
    NULL                                                     AS investment_strategy,
    NULL                                                     AS investment_group,
    NULL                                                     AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy,
    --------------------------------------
    -- helpful debug information
    --------------------------------------
    transactions.transaction_code                            AS transaction_code,
    'credit_investment_private_trusted_dev.cashflows_all_transactions, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security'               AS data_sources_list
    --------------------------------------
FROM
    credit_investment_private_trusted_dev.cashflows_all_transactions transactions
LEFT JOIN
    reference_dev.ci_sentry_security securities
ON
    transactions.security_identifier = securities.security_identifier
WHERE
    CAST(transactions.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE)
AND
    CAST(securities.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE)
AND
    TRY_CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE (securities.start_date) AND DATE(securities.end_date)
--AND
--  TRY_CAST(transactions.trade_date AS DATE) >= TRY_CAST('2025-06-19' AS DATE)
-- TODO: confirm if this is just because there is no underlying data
-- or there is problem in the logic
AND
    transactions.transaction_type = 'transaction'
AND
    transactions.is_cancelled = 'False'
AND
    settlement_date = ''
AND
    -- Filter out the transaction codes that should be excluded
    transactions.transaction_code NOT IN (SELECT code FROM excluded_transaction_codes)

		FROM

		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 11 and 12

		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 08 and 09
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 08:55:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* QuickSight fd1d2b8a-9ed7-4f3b-9851-1a12c960251c */
SELECT "business_date", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "ultimate_parent_party_name", "issuer_name", "parent_security_type_name", "security_type_name", "security_name", "total_market_value_pc", "security_name_clean", "combined_entity_name_original", "combined_entity_name_clean", "department_sorted"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join asset.enterprise_security /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite*/ secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name, '' ) as combined_entity_name_original
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name_clean, '' ) as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'
	  	  end department_sorted
	from (
		select
			  *
			, case
				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(leg|swap|swaptions|option|future|contract|deposit|paper|collateralized|bond|repo|revrepo|buyselback|selbuyback)\b.*' ) then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )
				else security_name
			  end security_name_clean
		from 
			lt_base
	)
)
select * from lt_final) AS "holdings_search_holdings_lookthrough"

FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join asset.enterprise_security /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite*/ secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'

			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'

			, case

	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 04 and 05
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 04:46:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-19'
)

SELECT DISTINCT 
    CASE 
        WHEN sec.abor_security_group_id IN ('SYN CR IDX', 'SYN EQ IDX', 'SYN FI IDX') THEN 'synthetic_index'
        WHEN h.abor_security_type_name = 'Public Fund' THEN 'equity'
        ELSE 'other'
    END AS table_name,

    h.abor_security_name AS instrument_name,
    CAST(h.scd_holding_key_id AS VARCHAR) AS id_parent_position,

    CASE 
        WHEN h.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL THEN h.cppib_sec_id
        ELSE h.abor_security_number
    END AS id_instrument,

    h.model_portfolio_id AS id_model_portfolio,
    h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS market_value,
    h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
    h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS pv,
    h.balance_nominal_number AS quantity,
    h.clean_price AS current_price,
    '' AS current_price_currency,
    0 AS variation_margin,
    h.quotation_currency_code AS quoted_currency_code,

    CASE 
        WHEN h.abor_security_type_name = 'Public Fund' THEN smp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
        ELSE ''
    END AS unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,

    '' AS final_fixing_date,
    '' AS returnleg_leg_type,
    '' AS returnleg_original_currency,
    h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS pv_fx,
    0 AS current_notional,
    '' AS interestleg_original_currency,
    0 AS interestleg_value,
    0 AS future_cash_flows,
    '' AS interestleg_leg_type,
    '' AS fx_rate_base_currency,
    '' AS trade_date,

    h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS current_nominal,
    h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS current_nominal_pc,
    h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS clean_market_value,
    h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS clean_market_value_pc,

    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS current_quantity,
    '' AS instrument_lot_size,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS underlying_instrument_price,
    '' AS instrument_type,
    '' AS instrument_family_name_source,
    '' AS instrument_group_name_source,
    '' AS instrument_sub_type,
    '' AS current_contract_id

FROM RankedSecurities sec
LEFT JOIN holdings.scd_holdings_main h
	ON h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
LEFT JOIN finance_accounting.model_portfolios smp 
    ON h.model_portfolio_id = smp.id_model_portfolio 
    AND smp.business_date = DATE'2025-06-19'

WHERE h.business_date = '2025-06-19'
  AND h.scd_holding_key_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (
        sec.abor_security_group_id IN ('SYN CR IDX', 'SYN EQ IDX', 'SYN FI IDX')

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 21 and 22
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 21:05:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

          AND (

                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (

            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'

SELECT

    perf.*,
    calc.gross_purchase_pc AS "Gross Purchase PC",
    calc.net_sell_pc AS "Net Sell PC",
    calc.total_cap_pc AS "Total Capital PC",
    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_pc,0) AS "Net Capital Balance PC"
FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main holding
INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp invstr
        ON holding.model_portfolio_id = invstr.model_portfolio
       AND holding.business_date = invstr.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec_ent.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency1
       ON holding.quotation_currency_code = currency1.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency1.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes country
       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN calculated_trans calc
       ON calc.bb_unique_id = sec.bloomberg_unique_id 
      AND calc.business_date = holding.business_date
      AND calc.model_portfolio_id = holding.model_portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN performance perf
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = perf.model_portfolio_id

                )

    ),

        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key

               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

    holding.balance_nominal_number                                                   AS "Share Owned",

    holding.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency                                    AS "Cost PC",

    mp.model_portfolio_id                                                            AS "Model Portfolio Code",

    holding.quotation_currency_code                                                  AS "Quoted Currency",
    country.country_name                                                             AS "Country of Exposure Name - Current",
    holding.balance_nominal_number                                                   AS "Balance Nominal/Number",
    holding.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value QC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value PC",

    calc.gross_purchase_pc AS "Gross Purchase PC",
    calc.net_sell_pc AS "Net Sell PC",
    calc.total_cap_pc AS "Total Capital PC",
    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_pc,0) AS "Net Capital Balance PC"

        ON holding.model_portfolio_id = invstr.model_portfolio
       AND holding.business_date = invstr.business_date

       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date

       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec_ent.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date

       ON holding.quotation_currency_code = currency1.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency1.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes country
       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN calculated_trans calc
       ON calc.bb_unique_id = sec.bloomberg_unique_id 
      AND calc.business_date = holding.business_date
      AND calc.model_portfolio_id = holding.model_portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN performance perf
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = perf.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.abor_security_id = perf.abor_security_id
      AND holding.business_date = perf.business_date
WHERE CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
  AND holding.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit', 'Right')
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id) AS "Holdings"
LIMIT 1000

	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 20:36:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 10:48:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

    FROM reference.scd_securities

)
select a.*, b.*, d.*, e.*,pr.*, f.country_name, g.currency_name, h.*,i.rating_agency,i.rating_value,i.rating_type,i.rating_date
   from (select ss.portfolio_id as id_portfolio,
		 ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
         ss.cppib_sec_id as id_instrument_new,
         ss.cppib_sec_id as id_instrument,
         'CPPIBSEC_ID' as instrument_id_type,
         ss.portfolio_id as id_portfolio,
         ss.scd_holding_key_id id_source_holding,
         null as id_enterprise_holding,
         sec.abor_security_group_id as instrument_sub_group_code,
         sec.abor_security_group_name as instrument_sub_group_name,
         ss.abor_security_type_id as instrument_type_code,
         ss.abor_security_type_name as instrument_type_name,
         ss.abor_security_name as instrument_name_source,
         ss.balance_nominal_number as current_nominal,
         ss.balance_nominal_number * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as current_nominal_pc,
         ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
         ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
         ss.quotation_currency_code as current_notional_currency,
         ss.quotation_currency_code as market_value_currency,
         ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_market_value,
         ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as book_value,
         ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as cost_value,
         ss.accrued_interest_quotation_currency as current_accrued_amount,
         ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
         ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_market_value_pc,
         ss.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency as cost_value_pc,
         ss.accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency as current_accrued_amount_pc,
         sec.abor_quote_factor as quote_factor,
         sec.abor_quote_type as quote_type_description,
         ss.exposure_portfolio_currency as exposure_pc,
         ss.clean_price as current_clean_price,
         '2025-06-19' as business_date,
         ss.quotation_currency_code as quoted_currency_code
		 from holdings_uat.scd_holdings_main ss
		 left join RankedSecurities sec
			on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
		 where sec.abor_security_group_id = 'CD'
		   and ss.clean_value_quotation_currency != 0
		   and ss.business_date = '2025-06-19'
         ) as a
    left Join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
          document_type,
          instrument_description,
          cusip ,
          isin,
          sedol,
          ticker,
          issue_date ,
          bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange ,
          bloomberg_unique_id ,
          coupon_rate ,
          coupon_type ,
          coupon_frequency_code,
          maturity_date,
          country_code as mds_country_code,
          exchange_name,
          region_code,
          market_sector_description,
          issue_country_iso,
          callable_flag,
          next_coupon_date,
          first_coupon_date,
          issue_date,
          par_amount,
          exchange_name,
          bloomberg_exchange,
          next_call_date,
          mic,
          issue_price,
          delete_date,
          cast(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new
          from asset.asset_money_market
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
         ) as b
     on a.id_instrument_new=b.cppib_sec_id_new   
    left join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new3,
          party_name, 
          bloomberg_company_id, 
          domicile_country_code,
          incorp_country_code
          from party.party
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
         ) as d
     on b.cppib_party_id_new=d.cppib_party_id_new3
    left join
         (select
          CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new3,
          cppib_country_of_exposure_code ,
          cppib_currency_code ,
          cppib_currency_of_exposure_code
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
          -- cppib_sector_classification_name_4
          from asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
         ) as e
     on b.cppib_sec_id_new=e.cppib_sec_id_new3
    left join
         (select
          country_code,
          country_name
          from reference.reference_country_codes
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
         ) as f
     on e.cppib_country_of_exposure_code=f.country_code
    left join
         (select
          currency_code,
          currency_name
          from reference.reference_currency_codes
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
         ) as g
     on e.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code=g.currency_code
    left join
         (select 
     model_portfolio_key,
     id_model_portfolio, 
     unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
     from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
     where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
          ) as h
     on a.id_model_portfolio = h.id_model_portfolio
     left join
          (
               select rating_agency,rating_value,rating_type,rating_date,CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new4
               from radar_reporting_uat.cppib_party_rating
               where cast(business_date as date) = date'2025-06-19'
               and rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
          ) as i
     on d.cppib_party_id_new3 = i.cppib_party_id_new4
     left join
          (select
           CAST(cppib_party_id AS int) as party_cppib_party_id,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
           cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
           cppib_country_of_exposure_code as party_cppib_country_of_exposure_code
          from party.party_enterprise_classification
          where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
          )  as pr
     on pr.party_cppib_party_id = cast(b.cppib_party_id_new AS int)

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-17')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-17')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,

                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,

    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",

    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",

    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-17')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

WITH
    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-06-06')
    )

SELECT
    holding.business_date                                                            AS "Business Date",
    sec.bloomberg_unique_id                                                          AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    TRIM(REPLACE(sec.bloomberg_cd, sec.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, ''))                         AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    mp.model_portfolio_name                                                          AS "Model Portfolio Name",
    mp.model_portfolio_id                                                            AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    mp.programs_name                                                                 AS "Programs Name",
    mp.canadian_foreign_emerging_general_split_name                                  AS "Canada/Foreign/Emerging Name",
    sec.sec_nm                                                                       AS "Security Name - Current",
    currency1.currency_name                                                          AS "Quoted Currency Name",
    country.country_name                                                             AS "Country of Exposure Name - Current",
    currency2.currency_name                                                          AS "Currency of Exposure Name - Current",
    holding.balance_nominal_number                                                   AS "Balance Nominal/Number",
    holding.balance_book_value_quotation_currency                                    AS "Balance Book Value QC",
    holding.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency                                    AS "Balance Cost Value QC",
    holding.clean_price                                                              AS "Clean Price QC",
    holding.clean_value_quotation_currency                                           AS "Clean Value QC",
    holding.dirty_price                                                              AS "Dirty Price QC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency                                     AS "Dirty Value Total QC",
    holding.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency + holding.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency + holding.next_dividend_quotation_currency + holding.next_coupon_quotation_currency + holding.accrued_interest_quotation_currency AS "Total Accrued Income QC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value QC",
    holding.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency                         AS "Fx Rate QC/PC",
    holding.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency                                    AS "Balance Book Value PC",
    holding.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency                                    AS "Balance Cost Value PC",
    holding.clean_price * holding.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency   AS "Clean Price PC",
    holding.clean_value_portfolio_currency                                           AS "Clean Value PC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency                                     AS "Dirty Value Total PC",
    holding.long_settlement_correction_value_portfolio_currency + holding.balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency + holding.next_dividend_portfolio_currency + holding.next_coupon_portfolio_currency + holding.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency AS "Total Accrued Income PC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value PC"
FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main holding
INNER JOIN listed_re_mp invstr
        ON holding.model_portfolio_id = invstr.model_portfolio
       AND holding.business_date = invstr.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec_ent.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency1
       ON holding.quotation_currency_code = currency1.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency1.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency2
       ON sec_ent.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code = currency2.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency2.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes country
       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)
WHERE CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-06-06')
  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
  AND holding.balance_nominal_number != 0
  AND holding.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-19'
)

    NULL AS id_enterprise_holding,
    h.portfolio_id AS id_portfolio,
    h.model_portfolio_id AS id_model_portfolio,
    h.cppib_sec_id AS id_instrument,
    'CPPIBSEC_ID' AS instrument_id_type,
    h.scd_holding_key_id AS id_source_holding,
    sec.abor_security_group_id AS instrument_sub_group_code,
    h.security_group_name AS instrument_sub_group_name,
    sec.abor_security_type_id AS instrument_type_code,
    h.abor_security_type_name AS instrument_type_name,
    h.abor_security_name AS instrument_name_source,
    h.balance_nominal_number AS current_nominal,
    h.balance_nominal_number * h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS current_nominal_pc,
    h.clean_price AS current_clean_price,
    h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS clean_market_value,
    h.balance_book_value_quotation_currency AS book_value,
    h.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency AS cost_value,
    h.accrued_interest_quotation_currency AS current_accrued_amount,
    h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
    h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS clean_market_value_pc,
    h.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS cost_value_pc,
    h.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency AS current_accrued_amount_pc,
    sec.abor_quote_factor AS quote_factor,
    sec.abor_quote_type AS quote_type_description,
    sec.abor_coupon_term_unit AS coupon_frequency_unit_source,
    sec.abor_coupon_term_length AS coupon_frequency_length_source,
    h.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency + h.next_coupon_portfolio_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
    h.accrued_interest_quotation_currency + h.next_coupon_quotation_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
    h.quotation_currency_code AS current_notional_currency,
    h.quotation_currency_code AS market_value_currency,
    h.next_coupon_date AS next_coupon_date_source,
    mco.country_code, 
    mco.country_name, 
    mcu.currency_code, 
    mcu.currency_name,
    mp.party_name, 
    mp.domicile_country_code,
    mp.incorp_country_code, 
    mp.bloomberg_company_id,
    ms.cppib_sec_id,
    ms.cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
    ms.cppib_currency_code,
    ms.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code,
    mb.cusip,
    mb.isin,
    mb.issue_date,
    mb.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
    mb.bloomberg_unique_id,
    mb.sedol,
    mb.ticker,
    mb.coupon_rate,
    mb.coupon_type,
    mb.maturity_date,
    mb.country_code AS mds_country_code,
    COALESCE(mb.currency_code, h.quotation_currency_code) AS currency_code_mds,
    mb.float_spread,
    mb.cppib_party_id,
    mb.coupon_frequency_code,
    mb.coupon_cap_rate,
    mb.coupon_floor_rate,
    mb.conversion_price,
    mb.conversion_ratio,
    mb.par_amount,
    mb.document_type,
    mb.instrument_description,
    mb.exchange_name,
    h.quotation_currency_code AS quoted_currency_code,
    sec.abor_instrument_type_id AS instrument_group_name,
    smp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
    r.rating_Value AS party_rating_value,
    e.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,			
    e.cppib_sector_classification_name_2,			
    e.cppib_sector_classification_name_3,			
    e.cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
    '2025-06-19' AS business_date,
    mb.issue_country_iso,
    mb.market_sector_description,
    mb.region_code,
    mb.callable_flag,
    mb.putable_flag,
    mb.convertible_flag,
    mb.next_coupon_date,
    mb.collateral_type,
    mb.sinkable_flag,
    mb.first_coupon_date,
    mb.issue_price,
    mb.bloomberg_exchange,
    mb.delete_date,
    mb.junior_flag,
    mb.senior_flag,
    mb.mic,
    mb.maturity_date AS maturity_date_asset,
    mb.next_call_date

FROM RankedSecurities sec

LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.scd_holdings_main h
    ON h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id

LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications ms
    ON h.cppib_sec_id = CAST(ms.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
    AND ms.business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'

LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes mco
    ON ms.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = mco.country_code
    AND mco.business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'

LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes mcu
    ON ms.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code = mcu.currency_code
    AND mcu.business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'

LEFT JOIN asset.asset_bonds mb
    ON CAST(mb.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) = h.cppib_sec_id
    AND mb.business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'

LEFT JOIN party.party mp
    ON mb.cppib_party_id = mp.cppib_party_id
    AND mp.business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'

LEFT JOIN finance_accounting.model_portfolios smp
    ON h.model_portfolio_id = smp.id_model_portfolio
    AND smp.business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'

LEFT JOIN risk_prod.cppib_party_rating r
    ON r.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
    AND CAST(r.cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(mp.cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR)
    AND CAST(r.business_date AS DATE) = DATE '2025-06-19'

LEFT JOIN party.party_enterprise_classification e
    ON e.cppib_party_id = CAST(mb.cppib_party_id AS INT)
    AND e.business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'

WHERE sec.rn = 1
  AND h.business_date = '2025-06-19'
  AND (
    (sec.abor_security_group_id, sec.abor_security_type_id) IN (
        ('BOND', 'CORPMKT'),
        ('BOND', 'GOVMKT'),
        ('BOND', 'NONMKT'),
        ('CONVBOND', 'CONVBOND'),
        ('CPPIBBNDIS', 'CPPIBBNDIS'),
        ('CPPIBBND', 'CPPIBBND'),
        ('CPPIBBND', 'CPPMTNS'),
        ('CPPIBREPO', 'CPPIBREPO'),
        ('TERM DEBT', 'MED TMDEBT'),
        ('IX BOND', 'GOVILB'),
        ('MBS', 'GOVMBS')
    )
)

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 04 and 05
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 04:36:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

		COUNT(*) as counter

		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 04:48:37'

	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

           --  cppib_party_id as rated_party_id,
           ticker from party.party
    where business_date = date'2025-06-19'
    --include ultimate parents for rating as well
    --union
    --select cppib_party_id, ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id as rated_party_id, ticker from party.party
    --where business_date = date'2025-06-19' and ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id is not null
),
ciq as (
    select
        cppib_party_id,
        debt_over_ebita as totalDebtOverEbitda,
        shares_outstanding as sharesOutstanding,
        market_cap as marketCap,
        enterprise_value as totalEnterpriseValue,
        debt as totalDebt
    from radar_reporting_uat.ref_legal_entity
    where business_date = '2025-06-19' and debt_over_ebita IS NOT NULL
),
--Need to pre-prep this portion to get the ISIN for PE lookthroughs applied
prod_pty as (
    select
        si.cppib_sec_id,
        pty.cppib_party_id,
        -- pty.rated_party_id,
        p.id_model_portfolio,
        p.security_type_name,
        p.holkeyik,
        p.pv,
        si.isin,
        -- max(si.isin) over (partition by pty.rated_party_id) as isin_agg,
        pty.ticker
    from products p
    left join asset.asset_security_identifiers si on p.id_instrument = cast(si.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
        and si.business_date = date'2025-06-19'
    left join parties pty on coalesce(p.cppib_party_id, si.cppib_party_id) = pty.cppib_party_id 
)
select
    p.cppib_sec_id,
    cast(p.cppib_party_id as varchar) as cppib_party_id,
    p.security_type_name,
    p.holkeyik,
    p.pv,
    c.totalDebtOverEbitda,
    c.sharesOutstanding,
    c.marketCap,
    c.totalEnterpriseValue,
    c.totalDebt,
    node.investment_dept,
    node.investment_strat,
    node.program,
    node.sub_program,
    node.model_portfolio,
    pec.cppib_country_of_exposure_code as country_code,
    abs(re.debt_carrying_value_local_cur / NULLIF(re.carrying_value_local_cur, 0)) as ltv_ratio,
    if(p.ticker is null, 'PRIVATE', 'PUBLIC') as ownership_type
from prod_pty p
left join (
    select
        business_date,
        id_instrument_alternate,
        sum(debt_carrying_value_local_cur) as debt_carrying_value_local_cur,
        sum(carrying_value_local_cur) as carrying_value_local_cur
    from alternative_assets.yardi_holdings
    group by business_date, id_instrument_alternate
) re on p.id_model_portfolio = re.id_instrument_alternate and re.business_date = date'2025-06-19'
left join party.party_enterprise_classification pec
    on p.cppib_party_id = pec.cppib_party_id and pec.business_date = date'2025-06-19'
left join ciq c
    on p.cppib_party_id = c.cppib_party_id
join radar_reporting_uat.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk node
    on p.id_model_portfolio = node.model_portfolio
where node.business_date = '2025-06-19'
and p.cppib_party_id is not null

union

--Join dummy RE lookthrough issuers from prev biz day as tactical solution
select
    cast(p.cppib_security_id as int),
    p.pos_source_system_key as cppib_party_id,
    p.inst_type as security_type_name,
    cast(p.holkeyik as bigint),
    calc.abacus_pv_base_ccy as pv,
    le.debt_over_ebita as totalDebtOverEbitda,
    le.shares_outstanding as sharesOutstanding,
    le.market_cap as marketCap,
    le.enterprise_value as totalEnterpriseValue,
    le.debt as totalDebt,
    node.investment_dept,
    node.investment_strat,
    node.program,
    node.sub_program,
    node.model_portfolio,
    le.secm_exposure_country as country_code,
    abs(le.ltv_local_cur) as ltv_ratio,
    le.ownership_type
from radar_reporting_uat.dim_pos_inst p 
left join radar_reporting_uat.fact_pos_calc_sd calc
    on p.pos_id = calc.pos_id and p.chron_id = calc.chron_id
left join radar_reporting_uat.ref_legal_entity le
    on p.issuer_id = le.legal_entity_id and p.chron_id = le.chron_id
left join node
    on p.chron_id = node.chron_id and p.ptfl_acct_code = node.node_name
where p.business_date = (
        --Lookback two days if prev day is a holiday with no data
        select case when exists (select 1 from radar_reporting_uat.dim_pos_inst 
        where business_date = to_char(date_add('day', if(day_of_week(date'2025-06-19') = 1, -3, -1), date'2025-06-19'), 'yyyy-mm-dd'))
        THEN to_char(date_add('day', if(day_of_week(date'2025-06-19') = 1, -3, -1), date'2025-06-19'), 'yyyy-mm-dd')
        ELSE to_char(date_add('day', if(day_of_week(date'2025-06-19') in (1, 2), -4, -2), date'2025-06-19'), 'yyyy-mm-dd')
        END
    )
    and (le.party_name like 'ISSUER FOR%' or (cppib_party_id is null and p.inst_type in ('REAL_ESTATE_JV', 'REAL_ESTATE_FUND')))
    and p.portfolio_type IN ('LOOKTHROUGH', 'IP')

with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),
old_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),

    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_alert_date as (
    select *
    from old_alert_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_alert_records
)

-- Get dealcloud interactions data

SELECT *
FROM
	-- Get dealcloud interaction dates per dealcloud company in direct way
	(SELECT DISTINCT dc.companyId, dc.companyName, dc.companyLegalName, dc.sector,
		dc.subsector, dc.companyUrl,
		ic.dc_interaction_id AS interactionId,
		date(i.interaction_date) AS interactionDate,
		dc.date AS dataAsOf
	FROM
		(SELECT dc_company_id AS companyId, name AS companyName,
			legal_entity_name AS companyLegalName, sector, subsector,
			date, max(date) over (PARTITION BY dc_company_id) AS maxdate,
			company_url AS companyUrl
		FROM dealcloud_company
		WHERE name IS NOT NULL
			AND (type IS NULL OR type = 'Operating Company')
		) AS dc
	LEFT JOIN dealcloud_interaction_company_mapping ic
		ON dc.companyId = ic.dc_company_id
	LEFT JOIN dealcloud_interactions i
		ON ic.dc_interaction_id = i.dc_interaction_id
	WHERE dc.date = maxdate
		AND ic.date = dc.date
		AND i.date=dc.date)
	UNION DISTINCT

			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,

		SELECT

	WHERE

		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::840cf1687f9a6e942e551717cf5e8923394e3044c321539ecb3ff06a187a122c */
SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     query_date,
                     CASE
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
                         END AS business_date
                 FROM params
             ),
             account_mapping_query AS (
                 SELECT
                     date_format(pam.as_of_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                 WHERE pam.as_of_date BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                           AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
             ),
             unioned_data AS (
                 select COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM account_mapping_query

                 UNION

                 SELECT
                     scd.business_date AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 WHERE CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                     AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
                   and NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM account_mapping_query fq
                     WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
                       AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
                 )
             ),
             daily_counts AS (
                 SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) AS record_count
                 FROM unioned_data
                 GROUP BY business_date
             ),
             average_count AS (
                 SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
                 FROM daily_counts
             )
        SELECT cast(avg_count as varchar) FROM average_count) T LIMIT 0

/* cppi::a04ec6cdbb3d374917729d000c2b91afd382ba53ea3659e303118113dd111c4e */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 02 and 03
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 02:15:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

left join
(
  select
    concat(CAST(h.account_id AS varchar), '00', lpad(CAST(h.security_identifier AS varchar), 4, '0')) id_instrument,
    s.scd_id security_no,
    s.currency deal_local_currency,
    concat(s.security_name, ':', h.account_number) deal_name_source,
    h.model_portfolio_id id_model_portfolio,
    h.market_value_net_base carrying_value_base_cur_deal,
    h.market_value_net_local carrying_value_local_cur_deal,
    h.market_value_net_base carrying_value_inc_adj_base_cur,
    h.market_value_accrued_net_local carrying_value_inc_adj_local_cur,
    (CASE WHEN trim(i.country_of_exposure) = '' THEN '' ELSE UPPER(i.country_of_exposure) END) country_of_exposure,
    i.currency_of_exposure,
    0 as deal_commitment_amt_base_cur,
    0 as deal_commitment_amt_local_cur,
    i.developed_or_emerging,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_itd_base, 0) distribution_itd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_itd_local, 0) distribution_itd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_qtd_base, 0) distribution_qtd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_qtd_local, 0) distribution_qtd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_ytd_base, 0) distribution_ytd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_ytd_local, 0) distribution_ytd_local_cur,
    0 as dpi_base_itd,
    0 as dpi_local_itd,
    (CASE WHEN trim(s.ownership_pct) = '' THEN '0.00 %' ELSE concat(CAST(CAST(CAST(s.ownership_pct AS decimal(38,12)) * 100 AS decimal(10,2)) AS varchar), ' %') END) equity_ownership_percentage,
    i.region geographic_focus,
    i.gics_sector industry_focus,
    '0.0000000 %' as irr_percentage_base_itd,
    '0.0000000 %' as irr_percentage_local_itd,
    null as key_investment_style,
    0 as multiple_base_currency_itd,
    0 as multiple_local_currency_itd,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_itd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_itd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_itd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_itd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_qtd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_qtd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_qtd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_qtd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_ytd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_ytd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_ytd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_ytd_local_cur,
    s.reporting_name,
    s.ir_classification primary_investment_category,
    null as secondary_investment_category,
    null as segmentation,
    0 as unfunded_commitment_amt_base_cur,
    0 as unfunded_commitment_amt_local_cur,
    null as vintage_year
  from holdings.ci_sentry_holdings h
  join reference.ci_sentry_security s on h.security_identifier = s.security_identifier and h.business_date BETWEEN s.start_date and s.end_date
  join reference.ci_sentry_issuer i on s.issuer_identifier = i.issuer_identifier and h.business_date BETWEEN i.start_date and i.end_date
  left join (
    select
      business_date,
      security_identifier,
      account_id,
      hierarchy_group,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_itd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_itd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_itd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_itd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_qtd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_qtd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_ytd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_ytd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_ytd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_ytd_base
    from trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_hierarchy
    where hierarchy_group = 'Paid-In Distributions'
    group by
      business_date,
      security_identifier,
      account_id,

    CASE

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 10:50:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

/* cppi::8de07b6abfe04fb74a42bdc44e6947b74c19030314317f4b7c30c38b12966c3b */
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( 
    with renamed_mp_codes as (
        select
            scd_model_portfolio_primary_key,
            model_portfolio_id,
            business_date,
            row_number() over ( partition by scd_model_portfolio_primary_key order by business_date desc ) new_to_old_rank
        from 
            (
                -- Goal is to keep only the latest record of each MP code
                select 
                    scd_model_portfolio_primary_key, 
                    model_portfolio_id, 
                    replace( business_date, '-', '' ) business_date,
                    row_number() over ( partition by model_portfolio_id order by business_date desc ) rownum
                from reference.scd_model_portfolio 
                where scd_model_portfolio_primary_key in 
                    (
                        -- Get unique MP primary keys that have more than one MP code associated with it
                        select scd_model_portfolio_primary_key --, min( model_portfolio_id ) oldest_mp, max( model_portfolio_id ) newest_mp, count( distinct model_portfolio_id) rename_count
                        from reference.scd_model_portfolio 
                        where business_date > '2024-01-01'
                        group by scd_model_portfolio_primary_key 
                        having count( distinct model_portfolio_id ) > 1
                    )
            ) mp_codes_with_row_number
        where 
            rownum = 1
    ),
    new_mp_list as (
        select 
            scd_model_portfolio_primary_key,
            model_portfolio_id
        from renamed_mp_codes
        where new_to_old_rank = 1
    ),
    old_mp_list as (
        select 
            scd_model_portfolio_primary_key,
            model_portfolio_id,
            business_date renamed_date
        from renamed_mp_codes
        where new_to_old_rank > 1
    )
    select 
        n.scd_model_portfolio_primary_key,
        o.model_portfolio_id model_portfolio_code_original,	
        n.model_portfolio_id model_portfolio_code_new,
        renamed_date 
    from new_mp_list n
    join old_mp_list o on n.scd_model_portfolio_primary_key = o.scd_model_portfolio_primary_key
    order by renamed_date     
 ) t

		SELECT

			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 06 and 07
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 06:15:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH 
	cred_exp_by_country AS
	  (
		SELECT
		  COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code) AS country,
		  parent.sovr_country_rating AS rating,
		  parent.sovr_country_outlook AS outlook,
		  GREATEST(0, SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(fact.credit_exposure, 0) ELSE 0 END )) AS tot_exposure,
		  parent.sovr_fi_limit AS tot_limit,
		  MAX( parent.region_fi_limit ) AS region_fi_limit
		FROM radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact 
		JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child ON fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent ON child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos ON fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
		LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.ref_country ref_country ON ref_country.business_date = parent.business_date and parent.domicile_country_code = ref_country.alpha_2_code
		WHERE
		  fact.business_date='2025-06-16'
		  and fact.business_date = child.business_date
          and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
          and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
          and fact.business_date = ref_country.business_date
		  AND parent.sovr_fi_limit IS NOT NULL
		  AND ( parent.IS_FI IS NOT NULL OR child.IS_FI IS NOT NULL )
		  AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
		GROUP BY
		  COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code),
		  parent.sovr_country_rating,
		  parent.sovr_country_outlook,
		  parent.sovr_fi_limit
	  )

	SELECT *
	FROM
	  (
		SELECT
		  country,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN 'OK'
		    WHEN (tot_exposure / COALESCE(GREATEST(tot_limit, 1), 1)) > 1 THEN 'BREACH'
		    ELSE 'OK'
		  END AS status,
		  rating,
		  outlook,
		  tot_exposure/1000000 AS tot_exposure,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN -1
			WHEN tot_limit = 0 THEN 0
			ELSE tot_limit / 1000000
		  END AS tot_limit,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 THEN '-'
			WHEN tot_exposure > tot_limit THEN '0'
			ELSE format('%,.0f', truncate( ( tot_limit - GREATEST( 0, tot_exposure ) ) / 1000000))
		  END AS tot_avail,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN tot_limit = -1 OR tot_limit = 0 OR tot_limit IS NULL THEN 0
		  	ELSE ROUND( GREATEST( 0, tot_exposure / tot_limit * 100), 1)
		  END AS tot_usage
		FROM cred_exp_by_country
		UNION ALL
		SELECT
		  'Eurozone' AS country,
		  CASE
		    WHEN SUM( COALESCE( tot_exposure, 0 ) ) > region_fi_limit THEN 'BREACH'
		    ELSE 'OK'
		  END AS status,
		  '' AS rating,
		  '' AS outlook,
		  SUM( tot_exposure ) / 1000000 AS tot_exposure,
		  COALESCE( region_fi_limit / 1000000, 0 ) AS tot_limit,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN SUM( tot_exposure ) > region_fi_limit THEN '0'
			ELSE COALESCE( format('%,.0f', truncate( ( region_fi_limit - GREATEST( 0, SUM( tot_exposure ) ) ) / 1000000 ) ), '-' )
		  END AS tot_avail,
		  CASE
		  	WHEN region_fi_limit = 0 OR region_fi_limit IS NULL THEN 0
		  	ELSE ROUND( GREATEST( 0, SUM( tot_exposure ) / region_fi_limit * 100 ), 1 )
		  END AS tot_usage
		FROM cred_exp_by_country
		WHERE country IN ( 'France', 'Germany', 'Netherlands', 'Spain' )
		GROUP BY region_fi_limit
      ) c
    WHERE c.status <> 'OK'
	ORDER BY
	  CASE WHEN country = 'Eurozone' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
	  tot_exposure DESC

		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000
